update.securityTitle: Version {{version}} with a security fix is available

update.notReady: The update channel is not set up in this build yet.
update.fileError: The update file could not be written.

update.downloadInvalid: The downloaded file failed its check; nothing was installed.
update.engineNotAllowed: This {{name}} version does not fit this version of the app.
update.engineVersion: {{name}} reported version {{got}} instead of {{want}}; nothing was installed.
update.engineRefused: {{name}} refused our settings ({{reason}}); nothing was installed.
update.engineSwitched: {{name}}: takes over after the app restarts.
update.nothingToRestore: There is nothing to go back to.
update.trialFailed: {{name}} {{from}} does not start. {{to}} comes back at the next app start.
